title: 第1章 无限被动系统第2章 处决
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 【叮！无限被动系统正式开启！】
【首次激活赠送10点生命能量。】
伊森·里奥从天鹅绒堆砌的温柔乡里猛地睁开眼。
十六年了。
那个从他婴儿时期就盘踞在意识深处的倒计时，终于归零了。
他深吸一口气，视线左上角浮现出一行半透明的字幕：
【无限被动系统】
【功能：收割生命能量解锁随机被动。每解锁一被动，消耗的生命能量等比增长。】
【生命能量：0，赠送10点。】
【已解锁被动数量：0。】
【注1：被动获得后无任何排斥，无任何负面效果，无任何改变身体外貌（战斗时可自主选择是否改变）。】
【注2：生命能量获得需要击杀任意形式生命。每1标准人族生命强度为1点生命能量，非超凡、智慧生命的生命能量获取减半，生命能量过低则不计算。】
【注3：所有被动均默认完全开启。任何时候都可以调节是否启用及生效百分比（0%-100%）】
【是否添加被动？】
“呼，添加被动。”
【添加第1个被动，消耗1点生命能量，当前能量：9点。】
【正在生成被动......】
【生成完成，获得被动：长命百岁。】
【长命百岁：每生存1日，寿命提高百年。】
伊森愣了一下。
随即，他一把拽过羽毛枕，把脸埋进去，肩膀剧烈抖动起来。
“噗......哈哈哈哈哈哈！”
别觉着伊森反应太大。
无限寿命这种能力，别说他一个穿成侯爵独子的人绷不住。
就是找来某个不愿意透露姓名的玩虫子的人他也绷不住啊。
他十六年前他在国道当减速带，被超载大货车一个照面送进这个世界。
还穿越成实权侯爵的独子。
本来锦衣玉食的就够羡煞旁人的了。
content_en:
【bite! The infinite passive system is officially launched! 】
[The first activation will give you 10 points of life energy. 】
Ethan Leo suddenly opened his eyes from the gentle land of velvet.
Sixteen years.
The countdown that had been entrenched in the depths of his consciousness since he was a baby finally reached zero.
He took a deep breath, and a line of translucent subtitles appeared in the upper left corner of his vision:
【Infinite Passive System】
[Function: Harvest life energy to unlock random passives. Each time a passive is unlocked, the life energy consumed increases proportionally. 】
[Life energy: 0, give away 10 points. 】
[Number of passives unlocked: 0. 】
[Note 1: After passive acquisition, there will be no rejection, no negative effects, and no change in physical appearance (you can choose whether to change it during combat). 】
[Note 2: To obtain life energy, you need to kill any form of life. Each standard human life strength is 1 point of life energy. The life energy gained by non-extraordinary and intelligent life forms is halved. If the life energy is too low, it will not be counted. 】
[Note 3: All passives are fully enabled by default. You can adjust whether to enable and take effect at any time (0%-100%)]
【Do you want to add passive? 】
"Phew, add passive."
[Add the first passive, consuming 1 point of life energy, current energy: 9 points. 】
[Generating passive...]
[The generation is completed and you get the passive: live a long life. 】
[Longevity: For every day you live, your life span will increase by a hundred years. 】
? ? ?
Ethan was stunned for a moment.
Immediately, he grabbed the feather pillow and buried his face in it, his shoulders shaking violently.
"Pfft...hahahahaha!"
Don't think Ethan's reaction is too big.
The ability of infinite lifespan is something that a man dressed as the only son of a marquis cannot handle.
Even if he found someone who wanted to remain anonymous, he couldn't hold himself back.
Sixteen years ago, he was working as a speed bump on the national highway and was knocked into this world by an overloaded truck.
He also traveled through time and became the only son of a powerful marquis.
Originally, being well-dressed and well-fed was enough to make others envious.
